title: Good Boys Get Upgrades
setup: Goodboy offers workers subsidized safety implants. Neon suspects the advertised benefits conceal a compulsory obedience channel.
escalation: Ghost enters the demonstration using a worker credential while Neon monitors a recovered implant. Muzzle shows only the public functions. A brief cyan-pink pulse from his muzzle causes a nearby test drone to obey before the console receives an input.
resolution: The crew extracts the implant consent terms and prevents their neighborhood's forced enrollment. Neon proves the chip can report location and accept motor-inhibition commands through a local relay. He builds a reversible blocker for that specific hardware.
continuity: Muzzle's full muzzle capability stays unexplained. The blocker affects known implants only; it is not a universal cure or hack. Consent and privacy become a new stake.
comedy: The upgrade's premium tier removes an advertisement played directly inside your head.
ending_hook: Muzzle notices Neon's handmade blocker and requests his technical file.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
